# stackfall board fixture v1
# Four full-height columns under the spawn area. Every piece that spawns
# above columns 3..6 is grounded in the hidden rows, so its lock commits
# hidden cells: the lock-out game over of specification section 4.5.
name: lockout-ready
description: columns 3..6 filled from y=0 down to y=19; spawn cells stay free
provenance: hand-built for T023 to reach the lock-out rule in one hard drop; independent of any piece sequence
# 22 rows from the hidden row y=-2 down to y=19; '.' is empty and a
# letter I,O,T,S,Z,J,L settles that cell in its piece color.
